raw_trips = spark.read.csv(
  "/data/nyc_taxi/incoming/yellow_tripdata_2024-01.csv", header=True
)  # deliberately NO inferSchema, NO casting, NO filtering

raw_trips.write.format("delta").mode("append").saveAsTable("bronze.trips")
caption: Bronze wants the data exactly as it arrived. Cleaning belongs to silver, not here.
